title: Mary Had a Little Lamb
short: Traditional (words by Sarah Josepha Hale · C 4/4 · play it with every note lit.

blocks.html: A first tune to pick, using only three notes at the start: E on the open 2nd string, D at the 2nd fret of the 3rd string, and C on the open 3rd string. In bar 4 the G is the open 4th string, the ukulele’s high G. To strum along, play C and G7 with four down strums in every bar; a friend can pick the tune while you strum.

blocks.name: music-player
blocks.cap: Play it: the score scrolls, the keys or strings light up as each note sounds.

blocks.html: The piece: American nursery song, sung to the tune of “Merrily We Roll Along”

sources.name: Melody as in our piano version of Mary Had a Little Lamb, which was checked against a note-name sheet from the University of California, Riverside (gluckprogram.ucr.edu). The chords are our own. Our checking script compares the two melodies beat by beat.
